headline: Nvidia partners with Cloverleaf Infrastructure to secure data center power, investing hundreds of millions
summary: Nvidia is reportedly investing several hundred million dollars and taking a minority stake in Cloverleaf, a company that provides power and infrastructure for data centers.
details: Nvidia has partnered with Cloverleaf Infrastructure, a company specializing in providing power sources and pivotal infrastructure for data center development. This strategic move aims to support the ongoing AI buildout.

Cloverleaf, founded in 2024, successfully raised $300 million in its founding year. The company acts as a crucial intermediary, connecting utility providers with data centers to ensure essential infrastructure.

While the specific terms of the deal were not disclosed, reports indicate that Nvidia's investment will amount to several hundred million dollars. This investment reportedly grants the chipmaker a minority stake in Cloverleaf.

This partnership is part of Nvidia's broader strategy to leverage its substantial profits to directly finance and develop AI data centers. By doing so, Nvidia aims to sustain the demand for its high-performance AI systems. Earlier this week, the company also announced a $1.5 billion investment in SB Energy, an OpenAI-linked data center project located in Ohio.
